type: Offline captures from the real game renderer, not a live world or GPU settings simulator
capture_backend: Linux SDL2/OpenGL software Mesa; owned game disc, no replacement texture pack
school: map1_s00; fixed camera; flashlight modes include a placed Grey Child at floor height between Harry and the school entrance door. Harry and held weapon do not cast flashlight shadows.
street: map2_s00; fog density and snow examples
parameters: Each option varies independently, remaining parameters fixed. Nearest sampled float value is displayed explicitly. Nonvisual settings have no image; unsupported visual examples are explicitly marked missing.
animation: PGXP camera track: 16 real frames, identical sampled path. Weather: 16 sampled frames at 12 fps; illustrative snow movement, NOT a display-FPS or latency benchmark.
rights: Derived gameplay captures retain underlying game rights. Not separately relicensed. Local test assets, no public upload.
weather: Two 60-frame, 60 fps clips captured from identical initial particle-module state and RNG. Particle callbacks use deterministic Q12 render deltas totalling 4096 ticks per 60 frames, independently of debugger wall clock; native weather_sim_hz controls 30 Hz stepping versus per-render updates. Original rendered 640x360 frames reduced to 480x270 for a bounded 32 MiB decoded cache. Loop wrap resets to the recorded start; not a seamless physical simulation.
hud: Actual in-engine minimap/crosshair and low-health warning; private disposable game state only. Crosshair drawn by original Pc_CrosshairDraw in isolated FPS scene.
beam: Modern flashlight fixed for intensity and size comparisons; all 31 native slider steps from 0.0 to 3.0 captured separately, no synthetic brightness or resizing of screenshots.
fov: All three native camera modes, 40 to 140 degrees in 1-degree steps; camera smoothing settles before capture and recorded camera eye stays identical across all values within each mode. Native camera/projection, not resized or cropped substitutes. Other settings fixed.
